column1: 21355§postpone§pəˈspəʊn§The sports meet was finally postponed because of the bad weather.§由于天气恶劣，运动会最终被**推迟**了。§
21356§skim§skɪm§My reading approach is to skim the book first to see what's important and what isn't. It saves hours.§我的阅读方法是先**浏览**全书，看看什么是重点，什么不是，这样会节省很多时间。§
21357§preface§ˈprefəs§I will not delay you by a long preface.§我的**开场白**不会很长，免得耽误你们的时间。§
21358§retain§rɪˈteɪn§The young lady retained her tennis title for the third year.§那个年轻女孩第三年仍**保住**了网球冠军的头衔。§
21359§culminate§ˈkʌlmɪneɪt§My arguments with my mum got worse and worse, and it all culminated in my deciding to give up school.§我和妈妈的争吵越来越严重，最后以我决定辍学而**告终**。§
21360§robotic§rəʊˈbɒtɪk§Thanks to all of you for coming along today to hear about how the robotic float project is helping with ocean research.§感谢大家今天来听关于**机器人**浮筒工程是如何促进海洋研究的讲座。§
21361§profile§ˈprəʊfaɪl§The successful entrepreneur's career is profiled in this month's journal.§这期月刊**概述**了这位成功企业家的工作生涯。§
21362§salinity§səˈlɪnəti§As the float rises to the surface it collects all sorts of data, most importantly variations in salinity.§当浮筒上升到表面，就会收集各种数据，最重要的是**盐度**的变化。§
21363§aggravation§ˌægrəˈveɪʃn§Carrying heavy boxes can cause aggravation of prior back injuries.§背部受伤时搬重物，会**加重**病情。§
21364§incident§ˈɪnsɪdənt§The most common type of road rage incident involves personal violence.§公路上因暴怒而发生的**事故**中，最常见的都与个人暴力有关。§
21365§previous§ˈpriːviəs§Coffee became cheaper than it had been for the previous years.§咖啡的价格比**前**些年低。§
21366§spice§spaɪs§Variety is the spice of life.§多彩的生活才**有趣**。§
21367§bore§bɔː(r)§There is such a wide variety of cultures in this program that it is difficult to get bored.§这次的节目中有很多关于不同文化的知识，因此不太容易使人感到**厌倦**。§
21368§lull§lʌl§In April a slight lull ensued, but the volcanologists remained pessimistic about this volcano.§四月接着出现了短暂的**平静期**，但是火山学家对此并不乐观。§
21369§betray§bɪˈtreɪ§If you treat him as a friend, he will treat you well and will never betray you.§如果你把他当作朋友，他就会对你很好而且绝对不会**背叛**你。§
21370§underlying§ˌʌndəˈlaɪɪŋ§Our understanding of the underlying causes of El Nino events is being confirmed by float data.§浮筒采集到的数据证实了我们对厄尔尼诺现象的**潜在**原因的了解。§改例句：EI Nino 拼写错，大写 I 应为小写 l（El Nino）
21371§dispiriting§dɪˈspɪrɪtɪŋ§Sometimes even the most expensive hotel can seem empty and dispiriting.§有时甚至最昂贵的酒店也会让人感觉空虚和**沮丧**。§
21372§opulent§ˈɒpjələnt§The research suggests that even the most opulent, luxurious hotels seem to have underestimated the most basic needs of their customers.§调查显示，即使是最**华丽**、最奢侈的酒店似乎也低估了顾客最根本的需求。§

21373§plush§plʌʃ§They investigated the so-called boutique hotels in the heart of downtown business districts, stately mansions located in the depths of beautiful countryside, and plush hotels built at the edge of tropical beaches surrounded by palm trees and idyllic blue ocean.§他们调查了位于城市中心商业区的所谓的精品酒店、坐落在美丽乡村深处的庄严的官邸，以及建在被棕榈树和田园般蓝色海洋环绕的热带沙滩边缘的**豪华**酒店。§

21374§dispense§dɪˈspens§Those in the business travel industry maintain that these serviced apartments dispense with all the unwanted and expensive hotel services that business travellers don't want.§那些商务旅行行业的人士认为这些服务式公寓**省去**了商务旅行者不需要的昂贵的酒店服务。§
21375§behalf§bɪˈhɑːf§He made an impassioned speech on behalf of his country.§他**代表**他的国家发表了热情洋溢的演说。§
21376§initial§ɪˈnɪʃl§Interest will be charged after the initial 60-day interest-free period.§过了**最初**60天的免息期后，就要开始收取利息了。§
21377§govern§ˈgʌvn§The discovery that language can be a barrier to communication is quickly made by all who travel, study, govern or sell.§旅行者、学习者、**管理**人员或销售人员很快就会发现语言可能会成为他们交流的障碍。§
21378§mingle§ˈmɪŋɡl§The waters of the two streams mingled to form one river.§两股溪水**汇**成了一条河流。§
21379§charter§ˈtʃɑːtə(r)§There's the Ticket Shop, where you can get inexpensive charter flights.§那是票务窗口，在那里你可以买到便宜的**包机**航班票。§
21380§formidable§fəˈmɪdəbl§The new coastline is being bolstered with a formidable twelve kilometres of sea defences.§新的海岸线被一条12公里长的**坚固**海防线保护起来。§
21381§belt§belt§Molten glass travelled over a moving belt of perforated steel oozing through the holes into moulds.§融化的玻璃流过一根移动的带孔钢**带**，通过孔眼滴入模具内。§改译文：belt 是传送带，不是钢条，改为「钢带」
21382§relay§ˈriːleɪ§The Olympic Games are relayed all round the world.§奥运会实况向全世界**转播**。§
21383§crockery§ˈkrɒkəri§You'll find all sorts of things in the museums: old suitcases, crockery, first-class cabins decorated in the fashion of the day.§在博物馆里你会看到各式各样的东西：旧衣箱、**陶罐**以及按当时流行风格装修的头等舱。§
21384§diversify§daɪˈvɜːsɪfaɪ§Farms have diversified in recent years.§近年来，农业种植开始**多样化**。§
21385§threshold§ˈθreʃhəʊld§The normal noise threshold for people is 80 decibels.§80分贝是人类所能忍受的正常噪音**上限**。§改译文：原译括的是半句话，改为「噪音上限」
21386§vacation§vəˈkeɪʃn§She's going to Florida for vacation.§她要去佛罗里达**度假**。§
21387§skyscraper§ˈskaɪskreɪpə(r)§As construction techniques improved, the skyscraper became a reality.§随着建筑技术的进步，建造**摩天大楼**成为现实。§
21388§draft§drɑːft§You must think a great deal before you start writing your draft.§你在开始打**草稿**之前一定要考虑周全。§
21389§deter§dɪˈtɜː(r)§They would be deterred from buying a product if it had been tested on animals.§如果产品在动物身上做过试验，他们就会**打消**购买的念头。§改译文：原译只括了否定词「不会」，改为「打消…念头」
21390§promising§ˈprɒmɪsɪŋ§Other members of the tribe scoured the country for promising fish holes.§这个部落的其他成员在全国范围内寻找**有望**捕到鱼的地方。§
21391§goal§gəʊl§Once you have achieved the first goals, you will move up to a higher level of study.§一旦你达到了最初的**目标**，就可以进行更深层次的研究了。§
21392§crush§krʌʃ§Be careful not to crush my glasses in the bag.§小心别把我包里的眼镜给**压碎**了。§
21393§stream§striːm§The leaves were washed by rain into streams and rivers.§树叶被雨水冲进了**小溪**与河流中。§
21394§urgent§ˈɜːdʒənt§His car is in urgent need of repair.§他的汽车**急需**修理。§
21395§maximise§ˈmæksɪmaɪz§Some airlines have cancelled less popular routes in an effort to maximise profits.§为实现利润**最大化**，一些航空公司取消了不太火爆的路线。§

21396§sleek§sliːk§Not only sleeping and living accommodation, but also a sleek modern kitchen allows guests to cook and entertain if they wish at no additional cost.§如果客人愿意，不仅可以免费住宿，还可以免费在**时尚**厨房中做饭和招待客人。§改译文：sleek 是时尚、线条流畅，不是豪华

21397§entrust§ɪnˈtrʌst§As a hotelier, how do you go about attracting people to give up the security of their own home and entrust themselves to staying in a completely strange place and sleeping in an unfamiliar bed?§作为旅馆经营者，你是如何吸引人们使他们放弃自己家里的安全感，却把自己**托付**给你，让自己待在一个完全陌生的地方并睡在一张不熟悉的床上呢？§改例句：them- selves 是排版断词残留，改为 themselves

21398§pamper§ˈpæmpə(r)§There is something very powerful in our need to be pampered and looked after; it's almost as if we return to being a baby, when everything was done for us and we felt safe and secure.§我们需要被**纵容**和被照顾的情绪很强烈，当所有事情都为我们做好，我们感到安全无忧的时候，几乎就像回到了婴儿状态。§
21399§veterinarian§ˌvetərɪˈneəriən§The woman wanted to be a veterinarian when she was a little girl, but she became a singer when she grew up.§这个女人小时候想成为一名**兽医**，但她长大后成了一名歌手。§
21400§demolition§ˌdeməˈlɪʃn§Creating the park required the demolition of lots of derelict buildings on the site.§建造公园需要**摧毁**旧址上大量的废弃建筑物。§
21401§derelict§ˈderəlɪkt§The building has been derelict for many years.§该建筑物已经**废弃**多年。§

21402§synchronise§ˈsɪŋkrənaɪz§There's an indoor arena for gymnastics, a stadium for track and field and a swimming pool for races and synchronised swimming and also diving.§这里有个室内体操馆、一个田径运动场，和一个用于游泳比赛、**花样**游泳和跳水的泳池。§
21403§ornamental§ˌɔːnəˈmentl§If you look out here to the south, you can see a circular ornamental pond.§如果你从这里往外向南看，可以看到一个环形的**装饰性**水池。§
21404§track§træk§The road system here evolved from the goat tracks followed by the early inhabitants.§这里的道路系统是在早期居民所走的羊肠**小道**的基础上发展起来的。§
21405§estuary§ˈestʃuəri§This area is in a sheltered part of the estuary.§这一区域处于**河口**的隐蔽处。§
21406§leaflet§ˈliːflət§You can find exact information about a patient on the patient information leaflet.§你可以在病人信息**单**中找到有关病人的详细信息。§
21407§cascade§kæˈskeɪd§The cascade falls over a tall cliff.§**瀑布**从万丈悬崖上倾泻而下。§
21408§irritate§ˈɪrɪteɪt§Foul smelling chemicals are often used to irritate the bees and drive them down into the hive's bottom boxes.§气味难闻的化学物质常常被用来**刺激**蜜蜂并把它们赶到蜂箱底部的箱子里。§
21409§hatch§hætʃ§Almost all the eggs in the farm will hatch into chicks.§农场里几乎所有的鸡蛋都会**孵化**成小鸡。§
21410§commence§kəˈmens§Most courses commence at 9 a.m. and run until 3 p.m.§大部分课程上午9点**开始**，下午3点结束。§
21411§initiative§ɪˈnɪʃətɪv§The major initiative by this car-manufacturing company was to adopt a totally multi-skilled workforce.§这家汽车制造厂采取的主要**措施**是雇用掌握多种技能的工人。§
21412§fruitful§ˈfruːtfl§The researchers' hard work has led to some fruitful discoveries.§研究人员经过努力工作，终于有了一些**卓有成效**的发现。§改例句：hard working 是形容词，作名词应为 hard work

21413§stationary§ˈsteɪʃənri§It seemed to me that there were almost as many serious problems when cars were stationary as when they were travelling at 90 miles an hour.§对我来讲，车**停止不动**和以每小时90英里的速度行驶出现的严重问题几乎一样多。§
21414§superficial§ˌsuːpəˈfɪʃl§Those who tend to show off in front of other people are so superficial indeed.§那些喜欢在别人面前炫耀的人实际上相当**肤浅**。§
21415§crawl§krɔːl§To prevent the queen from crawling up to the top and laying eggs, a screen can be inserted between the brood chamber and the supers.§为了防止蜂王**爬**到顶部产卵，可在蜂箱育卵室和蜂房上层之间插入一块隔板。§
21416§rotate§rəʊˈteɪt§European peasants in the ancient time would insert a wooden drill into a round hole in a stone and rotate it briskly to make fire.§古时，欧洲的农民将木钻插入石头的圆孔中，通过快速**旋转**木钻来取火。§
21417§spoil§spɔɪl§He wasn't going to let a headache spoil his holidays.§他不想因为头疼而使假期**泡汤**。§
21418§flask§flɑːsk§After the science experiment, students washed the flasks.§科学实验后，同学们将**烧瓶**清洗干净。§
21419§attend§əˈtend§Students under the age of 16 cannot attend any of the courses offered by the college.§未满16岁的学生不能**学习**本学院的任何课程。§
21420§rim§rɪm§The pattern around the rim of the plate was very beautiful.§那个盘子**边缘**的图案非常漂亮。§
21421§motivate§ˈməʊtɪveɪt§Pictures are used to help motivate children to read because they are beautiful and eye-catching.§图片因其美丽和引人注目而被用来**激发**孩子们的阅读兴趣。§
21422§patent§ˈpætnt§Walker never patented his invention.§沃克从未为自己的发明**申请专利**。§
21423§architect§ˈɑːkɪtekt§Among mathematicians and architects, left-handers tend to be more common.§在数学家和**建筑师**中，惯用左手者往往更为常见。§
21424§symptom§ˈsɪmptəm§This disease has some symptoms similar to a cold.§这种病的某些**症状**与感冒的相似。§
21425§tremendous§trəˈmendəs§This looseness in molecular structure gives the material tremendous "formability".§分子结构如此松散使这种材料**极具**“可塑性”。§改例句：英文句中的中文引号改为英文引号
